content: Let me try a different approach to fetch the page:

arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import urllib.request
req = urllib.request.Request('https://www.youtube.com/@EvaDraconis/about', headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15)
html = resp.read().decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
# Find external links
import re
links = re.findall(r'href=\"(https?://[^\"]+)\"', html)
for link in links:
    if 'youtube.com' not in link and 'google.com' not in link and 'youtube.googleapis.com' not in link:
        print(link)
" 2>&1
